prompt:
A sprite sheet of 6 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 2 x 3 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) gigantic ancient tree with a massive trunk and huge spreading roots, crown of dark leaves; 2) second gigantic ancient tree, mossy trunk, different shape; 3) moss-draped tree with hanging moss strands and blue-green foliage; 4) twisted old forest tree with lichen; 5) dead grey tree with bare branches; 6) tree with softly glowing pale blue-green blossoms.
Scale: the gigantic trees are about 110-120 art pixels tall and 90 wide, the others about 64-70 tall; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Create a transparent-background sprite sheet for a top-down pixel-art JRPG: SIX distinct standalone tree props in a TWO-COLUMN by THREE-ROW grid, reading order left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Large clear transparent gutters between all sprites, ample transparent outer margins, nothing touching, overlapping or cropped. Row 1: left (1) gigantic ancient tree with massive trunk, huge spreading roots and crown of dark leaves; right (2) another gigantic ancient tree with different silhouette and mossy trunk. Row 2: left (3) moss-draped tree with long hanging moss strands and blue-green foliage; right (4) twisted old forest tree with lichen. Row 3: left (5) dead grey tree with bare branches; right (6) tree with pale blue-green blossoms, rendered with gentle pale color only, NO actual light emission/glow effect. Both gigantic trees about 110–120 art pixels tall and 90 art pixels wide; other trees about 64–70 art pixels tall. Preserve consistent sprite scale and leave enough room for the two gigantic crowns. Classic three-quarter top-down RPG object perspective: top surfaces and front faces visible, upright trunk and base toward bottom, readable root silhouettes. Premium modern hi-bit 2D JRPG pixel art, manually designed hard-edged pixel clusters, each pixel consistently sized as a crisp square, pixel-perfect nearest-neighbor look; no antialiasing, blur, soft brushes, photo texture, noise or checkerboard dithering. Clear cohesive clusters of 3–10 art pixels, 4–6 shades per material. Rich earthy worn-in palette, hue-shifted color ramps with purple-red saturated shadows and warm yellow highlights. Neutral soft even upper-left overcast-evening illumination, clean base colors. Fully transparent background/alpha, not white or checkerboard. NO ground, cast shadows, drop shadows, night darkness, lighting effects, light sources, vignette, words, labels, or numbers.
